चेन् (often placed at the end of an objector's statement) ‘if it be argued that …’, न ‘no, it is not so’, Bādar. ii, 1, 35; Sarvad. ii, 158

चेद् (g. चादि, also separated by the verb [MBh.] or the verb preceded by न placed at the end of the sentence [ŚBr. xiv, 6, 8, 1; Bhag. ii, 33; xviii, 58; Hit.], rarely चेन् न in reversed order beginning the apodosis, Sāṃkhyak. 1; Sāh.; Śrut.; Hit.) ‘if not’ (= नो चेद् forming a sentence by itself, ŚBr. xiv, 7, 2, 15), ŚBr. xiv; ŚāṅkhŚr. i, 17, 1; Mn. &c.

चेद् (g. चादि) id. (forming a sentence by itself. e.g. दूरम् अपसर नो चेद् धन्तव्यो ऽसि मया, ‘depart to a distance, if not i.e. if thou departest not, thou art to be killed by me’), MBh. xii, 7, 21 and 29, 145; Pañcat.; Kathās.; Vet.; Hit.
चेद् exceptionally = न चेद् (beginning a sentence), MBh. xiii, 5809
चेद् or नो चेद् (with Pot.) ‘would that not!’ (e.g. नो चेत् प्रदहेत्, ‘would that he did not burn down!’), v, 676 ff. and 966
